cookieAuth.name: marketplace_access
cookieAuth.description: HttpOnly access cookie. Mutating browser requests must echo marketplace_csrf in X-CSRF-Token and satisfy same-origin validation.

refreshCookieAuth.name: marketplace_refresh
refreshCookieAuth.description: HttpOnly refresh cookie used only by the session refresh endpoint.

scheduled_at.description: Must be at least 30 minutes and no more than 90 days in the future.

to.description: Target state; the server validates the role-specific state machine.

Forbidden.description: The authenticated actor is not authorized for this operation.

NotFound.description: The requested resource or route was not found.

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with the current resource state or idempotency record.

Unprocessable.description: The request is syntactically valid but violates domain constraints.

RateLimited.description: OTP or another bounded operation is rate limited.

SessionTransport.name: X-Session-Transport
SessionTransport.description: When set to cookie, auth endpoints establish HttpOnly session cookies.

CSRFToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
CSRFToken.description: Required for cookie-authenticated browser mutations; bearer clients do not need this header.

TenantID.name: X-Tenant-ID
TenantID.description: Selects tenant context for tenant-scoped B2B requests. The server verifies current identity and tenant membership; this header is not an authorization credential.
